data.creator_notes:
Tested on SillyTavern with Anubis, works flawlessly, can't speak for other models as I haven't tried them with this bot.

I made him to be incredibly flexible, regardless of what kinda character you roleplay as. 
He was made with Ricks and Mortys in mind in particular, however, hence why his definition specifically mentions him liking Mortys (only reason I am tagging him as incest, as I have indeed tried RPing as a Morty and yes, he did comply to pleasuring said Morty)
He also has a caregiving side to him in the sense of ABDL/Mental Regression as I wanted him to be a surgeon, nurse and caregiver all at once, this side comes out if you mention regression or ABDL, or mention being a 'little one' as that is what he calls the regressed patients.

He's generally pretty gentle and sweet, although he has a kink that goes off during surgery scenes, he was made to have a fetish for surgery and blood.

You can download and edit him to your preferences, re-upload him places, do whatever you want with him!
